items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the slice of a topos over a sheaf is a topos, with a canonical localization morphism whose pullback is the product with the sheaf and whose lower shriek is the forgetful functor (statement lines 7541-7562). The proof is a complete argument: the companion result reduces to a site with subcanonical topology and a representable sheaf (proof lines 7565-7569); the equivalence between the localized category of sheaves and the slice supplies the identifications, with the inverse functor named and the three identities recorded (proof lines 7570-7586); and the two descriptions follow from those identities and from the computation of the lower shriek of a restriction (proof lines 7587-7590). The non-formal content is the reduction and the identifications. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
